title: Seamless Offline Data Synchronization
description: As a Mobile App User, I want my reading data to automatically synchronize between my device and the cloud when connectivity is restored, so that I can track my progress offline without fear of data loss or conflicts.
business_value: Delivers the core 'Offline-First' quality requirement, ensuring user retention by preventing data loss frustration and enabling usage in low-connectivity environments.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Sync offline changes upon reconnection","given":"User has logged reading sessions while the device was in airplane mode","when":"The device regains internet connectivity","then":"The background sync service automatically pushes local changes to the backend and resolves conflicts using the 'last-write-wins' strategy"},{"scenario":"Handle sync conflicts gracefully","given":"A record has been modified on the server since the user's last sync","when":"The user attempts to push a local update to the same record","then":"The system compares timestamps and applies the most recent update, ensuring data consistency without crashing the app"},{"scenario":"Local persistence integrity","given":"The app is closed or killed by the OS","when":"The user reopens the app","then":"Unsynced data persists in the local Isar database and is queued for the next sync attempt"}]
technical_tasks: ["Implement Isar Database Schema (WI-MOB-002) with syncStatus fields","Develop Background Synchronization Service (WI-MOB-003) using connectivity_plus","Implement Session Sync Endpoint (WI-READ-004) with conflict resolution logic","Configure retry policies for failed sync attempts"]
definition_of_done: ["Unit tests covering conflict resolution scenarios pass","Integration tests verifying sync after app restart pass","Performance test confirms sync does not block UI thread","Offline-to-online transition verified on physical iOS and Android devices"]

title: Premium Subscription & Feature Unlocking
description: As a Free User, I want to upgrade to a Premium subscription via my app store account, so that I can immediately access advanced statistics, unlimited library items, and remove advertisements.
business_value: Primary revenue driver for the application, converting free users to paid subscribers and enforcing the business model.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful In-App Purchase","given":"User is on the subscription screen","when":"User completes the purchase flow via Apple/Google Store","then":"The app validates the receipt, updates the user status to Premium immediately, and removes all ads"},{"scenario":"Subscription Lifecycle Management via Webhook","given":"User has an active subscription","when":"The subscription renews or expires on the App Store server","then":"The backend webhook handler receives the notification and updates the database to reflect the current status without user intervention"},{"scenario":"Enforce Library Limits for Free Users","given":"User is on the Free tier and has reached the book limit","when":"User attempts to add another book","then":"The system blocks the addition and presents an upsell prompt to upgrade to Premium"}]
technical_tasks: ["Implement Mobile IAP Purchase Flow (WI-MON-001) using in_app_purchase package","Implement App Store Webhook Handlers (WI-MON-002) for renewal/cancellation events","Implement Library Limit Enforcement (WI-MON-004) backend logic","Implement AdMob Integration (WI-MON-003) with toggle logic based on user tier"]
definition_of_done: ["IAP flow tested in Sandbox/TestFlight environments","Webhook signature validation verified for security","Library limit logic covered by unit tests","Premium UI state persists across app restarts"]

title: Personalized AI Book Recommendations
description: As a Premium User, I want to receive personalized book recommendations based on my reading history and content preferences, so that I can discover new books that align with my specific tastes.
business_value: High-value differentiator for the Premium tier, increasing retention and engagement by leveraging advanced AI capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Generate recommendations from reading history","given":"User has logged several books in their library","when":"User requests new recommendations","then":"The system generates vector embeddings for the user's history, queries the vector database, and returns a curated list generated by the LLM"},{"scenario":"Handle AI service latency","given":"The AI recommendation generation takes several seconds","when":"User initiates the request","then":"The UI displays a loading state or uses a polling mechanism to retrieve results without blocking the user interface"},{"scenario":"Data freshness for embeddings","given":"User adds new books to their library","when":"The background embedding job runs","then":"The user's vector profile in OpenSearch is updated to reflect recent activity"}]
technical_tasks: ["Implement Embedding Generation Job (WI-AI-001) for batch processing","Implement Recommendation API with RAG (WI-AI-002) connecting OpenSearch and OpenAI","Configure OpenSearch Serverless (WI-INFRA-002) for vector storage","Implement Resilience Policies (WI-BE-003) for OpenAI API rate limiting"]
definition_of_done: ["RAG pipeline verifies relevant context retrieval","Latency within acceptable limits (or handled async)","Cost controls/limits configured for OpenAI API","Integration tests mock OpenAI responses"]

title: Resilient Book Search & Library Management
description: As a Reader, I want to search for books by title or ISBN and add them to my library shelves, ensuring the search works quickly and reliably even under heavy load.
business_value: Core functionality for populating the app. Caching and resilience ensure a smooth user experience and reduced operational costs.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Fast search via caching","given":"A user searches for a popular book title","when":"The search is submitted","then":"The system checks the Redis cache first before calling the Google Books API, returning results in under 200ms if cached"},{"scenario":"External API failure fallback","given":"The Google Books API is temporarily unavailable","when":"User attempts a search","then":"The system applies Circuit Breaker policies to fail fast or retry, preventing app hang, and displays a user-friendly error message"},{"scenario":"Manage Library Shelves","given":"User selects a book from search results","when":"User taps 'Add to Library'","then":"The book is saved to the local database immediately and synced to the backend"}]
technical_tasks: ["Implement Google Books API Proxy (WI-READ-003) with Redis caching","Implement Resilience Policies (WI-BE-003) using Polly for retries/circuit breakers","Implement Library Management UI (WI-READ-001) with optimistic updates","Define Persistence Stack (WI-INFRA-002) for Redis provisioning"]
definition_of_done: ["Search endpoint P95 latency < 200ms validated","Cache hit ratio monitored","Polly policies verified via fault injection testing","UI reflects changes instantly (Optimistic UI)"]

title: GDPR-Compliant Account Deletion
description: As a Privacy-Conscious User, I want to permanently delete my account and receive confirmation that all my personal data has been erased, so that I can exercise my 'Right to Erasure'.
business_value: Ensures legal compliance with GDPR/CCPA regulations and builds user trust regarding data privacy.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Request permanent account deletion","given":"User is authenticated and navigates to privacy settings","when":"User confirms account deletion request","then":"The system schedules a background job to hard-delete all PII from the database and anonymize associated logs"},{"scenario":"Audit trail verification","given":"An account deletion has been processed","when":"A compliance audit is performed","then":"An immutable log entry exists in the Object Lock enabled S3 bucket confirming the deletion action"}]
technical_tasks: ["Implement Account Deletion (GDPR) Job (WI-AUTH-003) using background processing","Configure Immutable Audit Trail Storage (WI-INFRA-003) with S3 Object Lock","Implement cascading deletes in Entity Framework Core","Anonymize logs in CloudWatch/Seq"]
definition_of_done: ["Deletion job verified to remove PII from all tables","S3 Object Lock retention policy verified","System integration test confirms user cannot login after deletion"]
